title: Garbage collect the PRE-rename Klein style LoRAs: 15 old keys in R2, 7 on HF, and up to 0.72 GB stranded on every 4B user's disk
description: Follow-up to MPI-609, which renamed the 15 Klein style weights to their display names and split them into styles/4b/ and styles/9b/. The OLD copies were deliberately left standing everywhere, because the app released at the time still resolves the old URLs and deleting them would have 404'd a style-LoRA install for anyone who had not updated. Fabio, 2026-08-23: run this two or three releases after the release that carries MPI-609, by which point nobody is on a build that wants the old paths.
